# What's your Child Tax Credit worth?

> Estimate the federal Child Tax Credit, Credit for Other Dependents, and refundable Additional Child Tax Credit, including the income phase-out and filer SSN requirement. Entirely client-side.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This calculator vs. working out the Child Tax Credit by hand](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/child-tax-credit-calculator/vs-doing-the-math-by-hand.html)
